why_i_fit.en: I combine formal management training (PMBOK MBA, USP/ESALQ) with 3+ years applying scope, schedule, cost and quality on a real large-scale project for a Dutch multinational, reporting directly to international management. I have managed change, claims and contract control in a highly regulated environment, and I bring a rare market edge: authorship of an industry technical book with 3,000+ copies sold — concrete proof of my structured communication skills, essential for management reporting and stakeholder management.

Project Management

why_i_fit.pt: Espelho diretamente o que o mercado offshore/EPC busca hoje: domínio prático de cronogramas baseline, caminho crítico e forecast em ciclos de 15 dias, testado em projeto real de dragagem de grande escala. Emiti Avisos aos Navegantes, planejei SIMOPS e apoiei obtenção de Isenção de Praticagem — evidências concretas de que entendo tanto o cronograma quanto a operação física por trás dele. Alinho-me ao plano de investimentos 2025–2029 da Petrobras (~US$ 111 bi em CAPEX) e à demanda crescente por Engenheiros de Planejamento com histórico offshore comprovado.
why_i_fit.en: I directly mirror what the offshore/EPC market seeks today: hands-on mastery of baseline schedules, critical path and 15-day rolling forecasts, tested on a real large-scale dredging project. I issued Notices to Mariners, planned SIMOPS and supported Pilotage Exemption approval — concrete evidence that I understand both the schedule and the physical operation behind it. I align with Petrobras' 2025–2029 investment plan (~US$111B CAPEX) and the growing demand for Planning Engineers with proven offshore track records.

  • Espelho o anúncio: baseline, caminho crítico, análise de atrasos e riscos, avanço físico, dashboards.
  • Ferramentas apresentadas como conhecimento (MS Project), coerente com "conhecimento de ferramentas de planejamento".
  • Mantenho CREA, MBA/PMBOK, inglês avançado e disponibilidade imediata no Rio.
advantages.en:
Planning & Scheduling

  • Tools shown as knowledge (MS Project), matching "knowledge of planning tools".
  • I keep CREA, MBA/PMBOK, advanced English and Rio availability.

Domino nativamente os sistemas Drake/SAP RT da Petrobras — o que reduz a curva de adaptação em qualquer operador ou prestador de serviço que atenda a companhia. Isso me torna um candidato de baixo risco e alta prontidão operacional imediata.

I natively master Petrobras' Drake/SAP RT systems — which shortens the ramp-up curve at any operator or service provider serving the company. That makes me a low-risk, high-readiness candidate for immediate operational deployment.

I sustained multi-standard regulatory compliance (NORMAM-12, IMO/SOLAS/MARPOL and the NR 17/30/33/34/35 set) across 3+ years of continuous operations, including incident investigation with the QHSE team. That combination of training plus real practice is what sets apart a genuine HSSE coordinator from a safety administrator.
